title: Prospective validation of affine endpoint certification as a complement to CRABS

registration.self_hash_policy: The protocol hash is stored in PROTOCOL.sha256 to avoid a circular self-hash.

research_question: Under which stated signal, grid, conditioning, and turnover-cap regimes does exact affine endpoint certification add reproducible decision utility to CRABS exploration without mischaracterising CRABS' intended role?

claims_policy.neutral_null: The certificate adds no meaningful decision information beyond the prespecified exploration workflow.
claims_policy.pilot_exclusion: All existing Mammalia benchmark results are pilot evidence and excluded from confirmatory decisions.

software.oracle_rule: The oracle must import neither affine_diversification nor NumPy/SciPy and must use Decimal arithmetic.

semantic_scope.bound_meaning: conditional identified-set endpoint, not a confidence or posterior interval

empirical.eligibility: include only after extraction receipt and component attribution pass

excluded_from_public_artifacts.reason: No redistribution licence was located for the companion repository.

deterministic_validation.matching_rule: Only rho=1 cells may be described as CRABS-matched.

proposal_ceiling.censoring: Retain cells that do not attain a requested prefix; never replace a seed.

randomization.derivation: Canonical JSON of the cell without seed is SHA-256 hashed; the first eight hexadecimal digits are mapped to 1..2147483646.
randomization.r_rng: Set the derived seed immediately before every CRABS call and record the post-call .Random.seed hash.
randomization.pilot_offset_prohibited: The historical seed+1000000 convention is pilot-only.

thresholds.certification_runtime: median certification wall time <= max(2 seconds, 0.05*paired exploration wall time)

hypotheses.H1: Production and independent exact calculations agree within the frozen endpoint tolerance in every supported confirmatory cell.
hypotheses.H2: Finite standard exploration leaves a normalized deficit above 0.05 in at least 20% of prespecified nonzero-width cells at the largest attained prefix.
hypotheses.H3: The boundary constructor reaches both endpoints with normalized deficit at most 1e-10 in every supported cell.
hypotheses.H4: Certification changes at least 20% of prespecified decision-query statuses relative to finite-cloud-only reporting, with zero false certificates.
hypotheses.H5: The adapter and certification layer pass clean-environment tasks and meet the frozen runtime rule.

decision_rules.H1_or_H3_failure: Stop interpretation and repair; publication prohibited.
decision_rules.negative_control_failure: Stop and version a repaired protocol/harness before any new run.
decision_rules.H2_or_H4_failure: Report the negative result and prohibit must-have or essential-complement language.
decision_rules.H5_failure: Repair interface/performance or narrow the adoption claim.
decision_rules.external_theorem_review_absent_or_failed: No public scientific release claiming exactness.
decision_rules.empirical_licence_or_extraction_failure: Mark empirical cells ineligible before execution; do not substitute another empirical signal after outcome inspection.

analysis.primary: Complete cell ledger and prespecified stratified summaries with interval estimates across replicates; no significance test is primary.
analysis.reporting: Report continuous and discrete endpoints, all censored cells, every deviation, and native versus cap-matched CRABS separately.
analysis.exploratory: Any tuning, new signal, alternate semantic bridge, posterior propagation, fossil analysis, or rescue run is labelled exploratory and cannot repair a failed confirmatory gate.
